title: Cafeteria Point-of-Sale Bulletin: How Meals Are Priced on the School Nutrition Services Meal Account
content:
**Rule.** A reimbursable breakfast or lunch is charged by the student's meal status on the service date and the pricing level of the account's campus: elementary campuses use the elementary breakfast charge and the elementary lunch charge, middle and high school campuses use the secondary breakfast charge and the secondary lunch charge of that status in the price schedule of the School Nutrition Services Meal Account.

**CEP campuses.** At a campus listed as a Community Eligibility Provision campus (Cypress Hollow Elementary, Pecan Grove Elementary, Hollis Middle School) every student's reimbursable breakfast and lunch are charged the CEP meal charge, with the price basis CEP no charge, whatever the student's status; the CEP override applies to reimbursable meals only.

**Second meals and milk.** Only the first breakfast and the first lunch of a service date are reimbursable; another one the same day is a second meal charged the second-meal price, and milk bought alone is charged the milk-only price, for every status and at every campus, CEP campuses included.

**Zero-charge lines.** A reimbursable meal served at no charge is still rung up as a purchase line of 0.00 so the meal served is recorded.

**Status changes.** A status change applies to meals served on or after its benefit effective date and never reprices an earlier meal, except that a meal charged at a higher status rate on or after the effective date is corrected by a void with the void reason status correction.

## Ring-up table

| Line on a service date | Charged |
|---|---|
| first breakfast, non-CEP campus | breakfast charge of the status at the campus level |
| first lunch, non-CEP campus | lunch charge of the status at the campus level |
| first breakfast or lunch, CEP campus | CEP meal charge (price basis CEP no charge) |
| second breakfast or second lunch, any campus | second-meal price |
| milk bought alone, any campus | milk-only price |

## Cases (hypothetical)

- A Free Meal Status student at Bluebonnet Trail Elementary takes breakfast and lunch: two lines of 0.00 are rung up.
- The same day the student takes a second lunch: that line is a second meal at the second-meal price.
- A reduced-price approval takes effect on a Wednesday. A lunch served that Wednesday but charged at the paid rate is corrected by a status-correction void; a lunch served the Tuesday before keeps its paid price.
